extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) 2D shapes through paper folding — fold a square paper diagonally to make a triangle, fold a circle paper in half to make a semi-circle. Shapes can be made by folding and cutting paper. (2) Attributes of 2D shapes — sides are the straight edges of a shape, corners (vertices) are where two sides meet. Triangle: 3 sides, 3 corners. Square: 4 equal sides, 4 corners. Rectangle: 4 sides (2 long, 2 short), 4 corners. Circle: 0 sides, 0 sides, 0 corners (curved boundary). Oval: 0 sides, 0 corners (like a stretched circle). (3) Straight lines — a straight line does not bend. Can be drawn by paper folding (fold paper and the crease is a straight line), by using a straightedge (ruler), by stretching a string tight. (4) Horizontal, vertical, and slanting lines — horizontal goes left to right (like the horizon, table edge), vertical goes up and down (like a door edge, flag pole), slanting/diagonal goes at an angle (like a ladder, roof of a house). (5) Curved lines — a curved line bends, it is not straight. Examples: rainbow, river path, smile. Curved lines can be drawn by freehand or by tracing round objects. Misconceptions: 'a circle has 1 side' (a circle has 0 sides — a side must be straight, the circle's boundary is curved not straight), 'square and rectangle are the same' (square has 4 EQUAL sides, rectangle has 2 long and 2 short sides), 'all straight lines are the same' (straight lines can be horizontal, vertical, or slanting), 'a curved line is a straight line that bends a little' (a curved line is NOT straight at all, it bends throughout). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function ShapesLinesGame), NOT export default. Export interface ShapesLinesGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
